Seven Hills Wheelmen Tuesday Night Ride

Paxton, MA · Road

Seven Hills Wheelmen Tuesday Night Ride is a road group ride in Paxton, MA. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Paxton Center School. About 23 miles, 14–16 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @sevenhillswheelmen the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Seven Hills Wheelmen Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A 23-mile Tuesday evening loop through the hills west of Worcester, from the school lot in Paxton. Moderate pace. The Wheelmen keep a public list of a dozen other recurring rides across central Massachusetts and the Quiet Corner of Connecticut.
